summary.seed_only_diversity_assessment: Insufficient convincing identity diversity: all eight generic-prompt portraits share a young adult, short brown/dark-haired, clean-shaven or lightly stubbled facial template. Small differences in lips, skin shade, jaw, hairline and pose are visible, but conservative grouping treats them as one related-looking family. This is not proof of exact identity collapse, and hashes cannot establish identity diversity.
summary.varied_prompt_assessment: 012–015 show clearly broader visible variation in age appearance, skin tone, hair and facial hair than the seed-only cohort. Nationality or ethnicity is not inferred from an image.
summary.quality_caveat: Images are substantially photographic, with mild smoothing and occasional collar construction artifacts. Photographic quality does not establish sufficient diversity or adapter benefit.
summary.teacher_memorization: Not assessed; no held-out teacher images opened.
